delivery_method: Barley spray SIGS (20 ng/uL, local + systemic)
reported_silencing_or_outcome: Silenced CYP51A (-58%), CYP51B (-50%), CYP51C (-48%); systemic inhibition required fungal FgDCL1
sequence_provenance: Gene-level & 791-nt span verified in PMC5063301 XML; full sequence in external S1
limitations_and_context: Detached barley leaf cut-edge uptake amplifies vascular translocation vs field intact wheat.

reported_silencing_or_outcome: Barley SIGS reduced infected leaf area 78-93% (triple 93% > single 78-82%); HIGS 7-62%
limitations_and_context: Co-silencing of untargeted paralogs occurred despite absence of contiguous identity; KO previously non-lethal.

delivery_method: Topical dsRNA/sRNA on tomato, strawberry, grape + HIGS
reported_silencing_or_outcome: Demonstrated fungal uptake of external dsRNA/sRNA; inhibited gray mold lesions
limitations_and_context: B. cinerea shows high intrinsic dsRNA uptake, not generalizable to low-uptake fungi (see Qiao 2021).

reported_silencing_or_outcome: Manual long double-dsRNAs achieved avg 32% (AGO1), 49% (AGO2), 77% (DCL1), 63% (DCL2) transcript silencing
limitations_and_context: Manually chosen longer regions outperformed shorter tool-selected 173-193 nt regions.

delivery_method: Foliar topical dsRNA on B. napus & A. thaliana
reported_silencing_or_outcome: Reduced lesion areas 64-71% in S. sclerotiorum and avg 66% across 5 homologous B. cinerea targets
sequence_provenance: Verified in PMC5943259 XML & Table 1 (primer table external Additional file 3)
limitations_and_context: 20+ targets screened; only subset yielded robust protection in detached-leaf assay.

reported_silencing_or_outcome: Downregulated all 3 ergosterol transcripts & reduced postharvest decay; 100-fold fungicide reduction in synergy

reported_silencing_or_outcome: All 3 open-air/greenhouse delivery routes reduced gray mold lesion severity
limitations_and_context: Demonstrates delivery method strongly modulates persistence (petiole vs surface).

delivery_method: In vitro asiRNA feeding + rice spray + transgenic HIGS
reported_silencing_or_outcome: asiR1115 inhibited hyphal growth & rice lesions (50-100 nM) + decreased MoAP1 mRNA

limitations_and_context: Conversely asiRNAs targeting MoACT, MoSSADH, MoSOM1 failed to affect growth (see Ambiguous record).

reported_silencing_or_outcome: NO uptake & NO disease suppression in C. gloeosporioides; weak uptake in beneficial T. virens; cell-type limited in P. infestans (contrast high uptake in B. cinerea/S. sclerotiorum/V. dahliae)

reported_silencing_or_outcome: Complete 'No silencing' of FgAGO1 reported in two tool-designed short constructs (AGO1-DCL2, AGO1-AGO2), plus only 6% avg silencing for tool-designed AGO1 vs 32% manual
limitations_and_context: Demonstrates computational siRNA tool selection can underperform or fail entirely compared to longer fragments.

delivery_method: Foliar topical dsRNA on B. napus
reported_silencing_or_outcome: KO-essential Ssoah (FPKM >5,200) & high-expr SS1G_10167 (FPKM ~24,000) had NO significant impact on lesion size; SS1G_06305 significantly INCREASED lesion size by 129% (p<8e-4)!
sequence_provenance: Verified verbatim in PMC5943259 XML & Table 1
limitations_and_context: Direct refutation of assuming high expression or knockout essentiality guarantees disease reduction via SIGS.

delivery_method: In vitro fungal asiRNA feeding assay
reported_silencing_or_outcome: asiRNAs targeting MoACT, MoSSADH, and MoSOM1 failed to affect M. oryzae colony growth
sequence_provenance: Verified in PMC6465682 XML Abstract & Results
limitations_and_context: Only 1 of 4 tested target genes (MoAP1) yielded inhibitory growth/pathogenicity phenotypes.

delivery_method: Detached tomato leaf + liquid culture assay (20 ng/uL)
reported_silencing_or_outcome: 67% of proposed targets showed disease reduction effectiveness, leaving ~33% failing to confer strong lesion control despite qRT-PCR mRNA knockdown and >45% PHI homology
sequence_provenance: Verified in PMC13205770 XML Abstract & Results
limitations_and_context: Crucial benchmark: even curated pipeline targets achieving >90% qRT-PCR knockdown do not guarantee in planta disease suppression (~1/3 non-protective).
